slice: camshafts, valves, springs and cooling, round 2

products.what_it_changes: One-piece forged Ti3Al titanium valve with CrN coating for surface hardness and lower friction; ProX says it meets or exceeds OE dimensions and reliability. It is a stock-replacement part for a top-end rebuild, not a performance upgrade.
products.supporting_parts: Replace with valve springs, seals and check seats/guides; set clearance with shims. The 2013-2022 part is 28.6333-1 (maker page prox-titanium-exhaust-valve-21), which does not fit 2023+.
products.caveats: ProX prints years, makes and models as separate lists, so the exact year for each model is inferred. The GasGas years are the least certain. No matching 2023+ KTM 250 intake valve page was found.

fits.notes: ProX fitment: years 2020-2024, Kawasaki KX250/KX250X, no 'Show All' truncation, https://www.pro-x.com/product/prox-titanium-exhaust-valve-16/
Same ProX list; KX250X starts 2021 in roster, https://www.pro-x.com/product/prox-titanium-exhaust-valve-16/

products.what_it_changes: One-piece forged Ti3Al titanium valve with CrN coating for surface hardness and lower friction; ProX says it meets or exceeds OE dimensions and reliability. It is a stock-replacement part for a top-end rebuild, not a performance upgrade.
products.supporting_parts: Valve springs, stem seals and shims at rebuild. The 2025+ KX250 uses a different ProX exhaust valve (found on Maciag only, no part number).
products.caveats: No OEM cross-reference printed. The matching 2020-2024 KX250 intake valve was not found on pro-x.com.

products.what_it_changes: One-piece forged Ti3Al titanium valve with CrN coating for surface hardness and lower friction; ProX says it meets or exceeds OE dimensions and reliability. It is a stock-replacement part for a top-end rebuild, not a performance upgrade.
products.supporting_parts: Valve springs, seals and shims. 2023+ YZ450F uses 28.2453-2 instead.
products.caveats: ProX's own page prints a combined 2020-2025 year list, which is wider than the dealer table. Maciag also lists this part (EAN 0193564324245) as YZ450F 20-22, WR450F 21-23. ProX says 'Ships in 1-2 Weeks'. The page does not say whether the YZ450FX 2020 is covered.

fits.notes: Ghostbikes fitment table for MPN 28.2453-2: YZ 450 F 2023-2026, https://www.ghostbikes.com/products/2490145-prox-valve-for-yamaha-wrf450-2024-2026-titanium

products.what_it_changes: One-piece forged Ti3Al titanium valve with CrN coating for surface hardness and lower friction; ProX says it meets or exceeds OE dimensions and reliability. It is a stock-replacement part for a top-end rebuild, not a performance upgrade.
products.supporting_parts: Valve springs, seals and shims. Maciag lists a matching ProX titanium exhaust valve (EAN 0193564516381) for YZ450F 23-, WR450F 24-.

The listing does not say intake or exhaust; ProX numbering uses -2 for intake and -1 for exhaust, and Maciag lists a ProX titanium intake valve for YZ450F 23- / WR450F 24-. The exhaust part number (probably 28.2453-1) is not confirmed.

products.what_it_changes: Titanium intake valve sold singly as a direct OEM replacement ('meeting or exceeding OEM specifications', Cycle Gear listing).
products.supporting_parts: Valve springs, seals and shims. Set clearances after fitting.
products.caveats: Authorized dealer table, not pro-x.com. 450 XC-F is not in the table. The table includes 2019-2022 and 2023+ engines under one part; confirm with ProX before ordering for 2023+.

products.product: ProX Steel Exhaust Valve - Honda CRF450R/RX

fits.notes: Cycle Gear 'This Product Fits' (Manufacturer Product # 28.1413-1, material Steel): CRF450R 2013-2026, https://www.cyclegear.com/parts/pro-x-exhaust-valve-honda-crf450r-rx-rl-l-x-rwe-r-s-2013-2022

products.what_it_changes: Steel (not titanium) exhaust valve that replaces the stock exhaust valve at a top-end rebuild.
products.supporting_parts: Valve springs, seals and shims. The matching ProX titanium intake (28.1417-2) was recorded in round 1.
products.caveats: Dealer table, not pro-x.com. A steel valve is heavier than a titanium one; check with ProX whether stock springs are fine for this valve.

fits.notes: ProX fitment: years 2025-2027, KX250/KX250F/KX250X (OEM ref 92057-0944, 56 links), https://www.pro-x.com/product/prox-camchain-kx250-25-26-kx250x-25-26/

products.what_it_changes: Stock-replacement timing chain made by Borg Warner in Japan. It replaces a stretched chain to keep cam timing correct.

products.caveats: Roster ends at 2026; ProX also lists 2027. Cycle Gear groups KX250 2021-2026 under one cam chain listing, which conflicts with this 2025+ part number. Use the ProX page.

products.what_it_changes: Borg Warner M-type timing chain with heat-treated pins, built to OE spec. It replaces a worn cam chain.
products.supporting_parts: Inspect the tensioner and guides.
products.caveats: Authorized dealer table. Missing years (e.g. FC 450 2026, MC 450F) are probably gaps in the table, not proof the chain doesn't fit. Motomentum also lists MPN 31.6443 as 'for KTM'.

products.what_it_changes: Borg Warner-made direct replacement for the factory cam chain.
products.supporting_parts: Inspect the tensioner and guides.
products.caveats: Cycle Gear prints no ProX part number for this listing. Get the part number from ProX before ordering.

fits.notes: 2022 ABRG (All Balls Racing Group, Hot Cams owner) catalogue, YZ250F intake cam 2019-2020, https://online.flippingbook.com/view/477292585/673/

2022 ABRG catalogue, YZ250FX page: Stage 1 intake 2020, Stage 2 intake 2020-2021, https://online.flippingbook.com/view/477292585/676/; Tokyo Mods lists HC00119 as Stage 1 intake YZ250F 2019-2020 / YZ250FX 2020-2021

products.what_it_changes: Bolt-in intake cam with Hot Cams' ITR ramp design for throttle response. ABRG says the 2020 Stage 1 intake is about equal to OEM at 3,200-5,000 rpm. It uses stock valve springs and needs no core.
products.supporting_parts: Pairs with exhaust cam HC00122. Check valve clearances after fitting; a fuel map change may help.
products.caveats: The catalogue text extraction did not cleanly pair HC00119/HC00125 with Stage 1/2; Stage 1 = HC00119 comes from the Tokyo Mods (dealer) listing. Firestorm lists YZ250FX 2020-2024 for the Stage 1 intake. No Hot Cams cams found for 2021+ YZ250F. Race use only in California.

products.what_it_changes: Higher-lift intake cam. ABRG says it gives a slight loss against OEM at 3,200-5,200 rpm and larger gains from 5,200 rpm to redline, so it is more top-end and less bottom.
products.supporting_parts: Pairs with exhaust cam HC00122. Check valve clearances.
products.caveats: Stage/part-number pairing inferred (HC00119 is Stage 1 per dealer). Firestorm sells a YZ250F 2019-2020 Stage 2 cam.

fits.notes: 2022 ABRG catalogue: YZ250F 2019-2020 Stage 1&2 exhaust cam HC00122, https://online.flippingbook.com/view/477292585/673/
2022 ABRG catalogue YZ250FX: exhaust Stage 1 & 2, 2020-2021, works with both intake cams, supplied with decompression mechanism, https://online.flippingbook.com/view/477292585/676/

products.what_it_changes: Exhaust cam used with either the Stage 1 or the Stage 2 intake cam. Supplied with the decompression mechanism.
products.supporting_parts: An intake cam HC00119 or HC00125.
products.caveats: Catalogue is from 2022; check current Hot Cams fitment for later years.

products.product: ProX Steel Intake Valve Spring Kit (conversion set) - YZ450F/FX/WR450F

fits.notes: Cycle Gear 'This Product Fits' (Manufacturer Product # 28.SIS2444-2): YZ450FX 2016-2020, https://www.cyclegear.com/parts/pro-x-steel-intake-valve-conversion-set-yamaha-yz450f-fx-wr450f-2014-2020

products.what_it_changes: Swaps the OEM titanium intake valves for nitrided steel valves plus stronger chrome-vanadium springs. ProX says the steel valves last much longer than titanium; the trade-off is more valvetrain weight.
products.supporting_parts: Reuse the OEM retainers, bases and seals (per listing). Set clearances with shims.
products.caveats: Only YZ450FX 2020 is in the roster. No ProX steel valve/spring kit was found for the 2021+ YZ450F, KTM 2023+, KX 2021+ or CRF 2021+.

gaps: Hot Cams: no camshaft or valve spring kit was found for any 2021+ roster four-stroke. The newest are YZ250F 2019-2020, YZ250FX 2020-2021, CRF450R 2017-2020 and KTM-group 250 2016-2022 (round 1). The 2022 ABRG catalogue is the newest maker source that could be read.

ProX valves still missing: the 2023+ KTM 250 SX-F intake, the KTM/Husqvarna 450 2023+ exhaust, KX450 2019-2023 and 2024+ intake/exhaust (Maciag shows 2024+ intake EAN 0193564556257 with no ProX part number), the 2020-2024 KX250 intake, the 2025+ KX250 valves, and the YZ450F 2023+ exhaust (likely 28.2453-1, unconfirmed).

ProX pages print years, makes and models as separate lists, so model-to-year pairing is inferred. Examples: 28.2423-1 lists YZ450F with years to 2027, and 28.SIS2424-2 lists 2003-2027. Both are older parts whose year list is padded by the YFZ450R ATV, so they were not recorded as roster fits.
Cycle Gear ProX cam chain listings for CRF450R, KX450 2024+, KTM 250/350 2023+, KX250 2021-24 and YZ250F 2024+ print no ProX part numbers; firestorm/maciag also omit them.

CV4: no maker site was found (searches for cv4.com return unrelated companies). Dealer tables (Cycle Gear) show CV4 MX hose kits only up to 2016 plus the CRF150R (not in roster). JJ Motorsports lists colours as part-number suffixes (e.g. SFSMBC100B Blue, SFSMBC47R Red) but with no fitment, so no colours were recorded.
Vertex: no Vertex valvetrain parts or cooling hoses were found for roster bikes. Searches return only piston and gasket kits.
Web Cams, Kibblewhite 2023+ spring kits and Xceldyne (a 2023+ KTM 250 SX-F Ti exhaust valve appears at an AU dealer) were not researched in this round.
